climate: Hot and humid climate, average temperature of 22-32°C, abundant sunshine.
possibleRisks: Blast disease, Stem Borer, Leaf Folder, Brown Plant Hopper, waterlogging/floods, drought during tillering.
idealSoil: Clayey or clayey loam soil that retains moisture well.

climate: Cool growing season (10-15°C) and warm, dry weather at harvest (21-26°C).
possibleRisks: Yellow Rust, Leaf Rust, Loose Smut, Aphids, sudden heatwaves in late spring (terminal heat stress).
idealSoil: Well-drained fertile loamy or clayey-loam soils.

climate: Warm weather (21-27°C) with moderate, well-distributed rainfall.
possibleRisks: Fall Armyworm, Downy Mildew, Stem Borer, drought at silking/tasseling stages.
idealSoil: Deep, well-drained alluvial or red soils.

climate: Tropical and subtropical climate, warm and humid (20-35°C), long sun hours.
possibleRisks: Red Rot, White Fly, Early Shoot Borer, frost during maturation, high water stress.
idealSoil: Deep rich loamy soils, alluvial soils, or black cotton soils.

climate: Warm and dry climate (21-30°C), minimum 180 frost-free days, dry harvest season.
possibleRisks: Pink Bollworm, Jassids, Aphids, Boll Rot, heavy rains during boll opening stage.
idealSoil: Deep, black cotton soils (regur) with excellent water retention.

climate: Warm climate (21-30°C) with moderate rainfall, sensitive to standing water.
possibleRisks: Tikka Leaf Spot, Collar Rot, Aphids, White Grub, poor pod filling due to calcium deficiency.
idealSoil: Well-drained sandy loam or sandy soils containing calcium/organic matter.

climate: Warm season crop, moderate temperatures (21-24°C). Extreme heat or frost drops blossoms.
possibleRisks: Early Blight, Late Blight, Tomato Fruit Borer, Leaf Curl Virus, blossom end rot (calcium deficiency).
idealSoil: Well-drained sandy loam or alluvial soils rich in organic matter.

climate: Cool climate (10-25°C) with low moisture and clear sunny days.
possibleRisks: Alternaria Blight, Downy Mildew, Mustard Aphids, frost injury during flowering.
idealSoil: Light to heavy sandy loam soil.

climate: Mild cool weather (15-25°C) with low humidity and frost-free conditions.
possibleRisks: Fusarium Wilt, Pod Borer, Ascochyta Blight, waterlogging.
idealSoil: Well-drained loamy to clayey soils with pH 6.0-9.0.

climate: Cool weather, night temperatures below 20°C required for tuberization.
possibleRisks: Late Blight, Early Blight, Potato Tuber Moth, Aphids, waterlogging, frost.
idealSoil: Well-drained, loose, sandy loam soils rich in organic matter.
